24.original: Speak with the distracted Hanu and slay any beasts that appear.

25.original: Speak with the distracted Hanu again.

49.original: Y-You there! You look fierce enough to brave the untamed wilds. Please, I'm in dire need of help...

50.original: A friend of mine journeyed southwest to Cave Kikitola a while ago, and still hasn't returned. I'm beginning to fear the worst has happened...

51.original: While it's likely he's simply lost track of time staring at the rainbow moss, I keep thinking about all the beasts skulking about... Please check up on him for me, if only to set my heart at ease.

52.original: I'll stay here in case he comes back, but in the meantime, visit the cave and search for him. I wager no other Hanu will be nearby, so he shouldn't be hard to spot.

53.original: My friend likely got caught up in the beauty of Cave Kikitola, but I would be grateful if you could check up on him. I will stay here in case he returns.

54.original: Ah, these waters get more beautiful every time I come...

55.original: Sensing a distracted prey, creatures move in for the kill!

56.original: What was that noise? Can't I gaze at the moss in peace...?

57.original: Wait, you're...you helped us bring back Ihih'hana! You're a friend of Wuk Lamat, yes? What are you doing in this cave?

58.original: Fiends, here? Oh, I didn't even hear them until the commotion was nearly over...

59.original: I owe you thanks for your courage! And now that my reverie has been broken, I should return to my friend. He must be worried sick.

61.original: He returned! He looked slightly unsettled, but none the worse for wear otherwise.

62.original: That cave is where we gather the rainbow moss used in our medicines. It has long been held sacred as a healing spot due to its tranquil scenery.

63.original: I haven't been since the great storm, and was worried that perhaps it had suffered damage in the floods... I am glad to hear that nothing has changed.

64.original: But more than anything, I'm glad my friend returned safely. Had you not come along, the day may have been much darker!
